policy: Each source entity has an independent country/polity track, grouped by source name; Wikidata IDs are used only for checked reference labels. Overlapping polities retain separate rows. Initial rows prioritize active large entities in the current map viewport, with continent diversity. Bands use original validity intervals and a shared proportional timescale. China chronology extends to circa -2070 with official-source evidence points; original political layers start at -403 and remain unchanged.
